arabic text: AAJ RUKHSAT HO RHI HAI TUMSE ZAHRA YA ALI
english translation text: TONIGHT, FATIMA ZAHRA DEPARTS FROM YOU, O ALI!

arabic text: PARDA E SHAB MEIN MERI MAYYAT UTHANA YA ALI
english translation text: LIFT MY BODY IN THE DARKNESS OF THE NIGHT, O ALI!

arabic text: PASLIYA TODI GAI KAISE YE BATLAUNGI MAI
english translation text: HOW WILL I TELL MY FATHER THAT MY RIBS WERE BROKEN!

arabic text: HASHR KE MAIDAA'N MEIN BHI IS HAAL MEIN AAUNGI MAI
english translation text: I WILL ARRIVE AT THE PLAINS OF THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT IN THIS STATE...

arabic text: HAATH PEHLU SE NA TUM MERA HATAANA\nYA ALI
english translation text: DO NOT REMOVE MY HAND FROM MY INJURED SIDE, O ALI!

arabic text: WO MUSIBAT AAP NE ACHCHA HUA DEKHI NAHI\nAB MAI SIDHE HAATH SE TASBIH PADH SAKTI NAHI
english translation text: IT WAS BETTER THAT YOU DID NOT WITNESS THAT TRAGEDY. NOW I CANNOT DO TASBIH WITH MY RIGHT HAND!

arabic text: AISA KUNFUZ NE HAI MARA TAZIYANA YA ALI
english translation text: QUNFUZ STRUCK ME WITH THE WHIP SO SEVERELY, O ALI!

arabic text: KEHTI HAI ZAINAB YE MUJHSE\nDEKHKAR CHEHRA MERA
english translation text: ZAINAB SAYS TO ME\nSEEING MY FACE,

arabic text: AAPKE RUKHSAAR PAR YE NEEL HAI KAISA PADA
english translation text: HOW DID YOU GET THAT BRUISE ON YOUR CHEEK?

arabic text: MAINE KHAYA HAI TAMACHA,
english translation text: MAT BATANA YA ALI\nI HAVE BEEN SLAPPED,\nBUT DON’T MENTION, IT O ALI!

arabic text: TAZIYANE KI AZIYYAT KA UTHANA EK TARAF\nWO TAMACHE, QATLE MOHSIN, DAR JALANA EK TARAF
english translation text: THE PAIN FROM BEING WHIPPED, THE SLAPS, THE DEATH OF MOHSIN, THE BURNING DOOR ALL ASIDE

arabic text: SABSE MUSHKIL THA MAGAR DARBAAR JANA\nYA ALI
english translation text: GOING TO THE COURT WAS THE MOST DIFFICULT, O ALI!

arabic text: JAB MERI TALQEEN PADHNA YAAD KAR LENA ZARA\nDAR KE GIRNE SE MERA BAAZU BHI HAI TOOTA HUA
english translation text: WHEN YOU RECITE MY TALQEEN, PLEASE REMEMBER, MY ARM ALSO BROKE WHEN THE BURNING DOOR FELL

arabic text: MERE SHANO KO ZARA DHIRE HILANA YA ALI
english translation text: SHAKE MY ARMS SOFTLY (FOR THE TALQEEN), O ALI!

arabic text: CHAHE AAJAYE QAYAMAT MUJHSE YE WAADA KARO\nJAB TALAK MAULA MERE SHABBIR KI MARZI NA HO
english translation text: PROMISE ME, NO MATTER WHAT MY MASTER, UNTIL MY SHABBIR DOES NOT AGREE…

arabic text: TAB TALAK MERA JANAZA MAT UTHANA YA ALI
english translation text: DO NOT BEGIN MY FUNERAL UNTIL THEN, O ALI!

arabic text: JAB SE AAYI HU PALAT KAR FIKR HAI MUJHKO YEHI\nMAI TO PARDE MEIN GAI FIR BHI ZAEEFA HO GAYI
english translation text: SINCE I RETURNED FROM THE COURT, IT BOTHERS ME. I WENT WITH MY VEIL AND IT STILL TOOK SUCH A TOLL ON ME!

arabic text: BERIDA DARBAAR HAI ZAINAB KO JANA YA ALI
english translation text: ZAINAB WILL HAVE TO GO TO THE COURT UNVEILED, O ALI!

arabic text: KARBALA MEIN JAB MERE MAZLOOM PAR KHANJAR CHALE\nPYAAS K AALAM ME WO GHAZI KO JAB AAWAAZ DE
english translation text: WHEN MY OPPRESSED SON IS SACRIFICED IN KARBALA AND HE CALLS FOR ABBAS WHILE HE IS THIRSTY

arabic text: MAI BHI AAUNGI WAHA PAR TUM BHI AANA YA ALI
english translation text: I WILL ANSWER HIS CALL AND SO WILL YOU, O ALI!

arabic text: HAATH PEHLU PAR RAKHE BOLI TAKALLUM FATIMA\nMAI DUA KRTI HU TUM AAMIN KEH DENA ZARA
english translation text: FATIMA SAID WITH A HAND ON HER INJURED SIDE, I WILL PRAY AND YOU RESPOND WITH AMEEN

arabic text: JALD AAYE MERE MAHDI KA ZAMANA YA ALI
english translation text: THE ERA OF MY MAHDI (A.T.F.S) SHOULD COME SOON, O ALI!

arabic text: ALVIDA FATEMA, ALVIDA FATEMA, ALVIDA FATEMA\nHAI BAAD BABAA KE JO, GUZRI VO, MUSIBAT SUNLO\nYA ALI, FATEMA ZAHRA KI, VASIYAT SUNLO
english translation text: FAREWELL FATEMA, FAREWELL FATEMA, FAREWELL FATEMA\nLISTEN TO THE TRAGEDIES THAT TRANSPIRED AFTER MY FATHER’S DEATH\nO ALI!, LISTEN TO FATEMA ZAHRA’S LAST WILL

arabic text: PASLIYA TORI GAYIN, KAISE YE BATLAUNGI MAI\nHASHR KE MAYDAAN MEIN, IS HAAL ME AUNGI ME\nHAATH PEHLU SE NA TUM, MERA HATANA, YA ALI
english translation text: HOW WILL I TELL MY FATHER, HOW MY RIBS WERE BROKEN\nI WILL ARRIVE AT THE PLAINS OF DAY OF JUDGEMENT IN THIS STATE TOO\nDO NOT REMOVE MY HAND FROM MY (INJURED) SIDE, O ALI

arabic text: WOH MUSIBAT AAP NE, ACHA HUWA DEKHI NAHI\nAB ME SEEDHE HAATH SE TASBIH, HI PARDH SAKTI NAHI\nAAISA QUNFUZ NE HAI MARA, TAZIYANA, YA ALI
english translation text: IT WAS BETTER YOU DID NOT WITNESS THAT TRAGEDY, YOURSELF\nNOW I CANNOT USE THE ROSARY (TASBIH) WITH MY RIGHT HAND\nQUNFUZ (L.A) STRUCK ME SO SEVERELY WITH THE WHIP, O ALI

arabic text: KEHTI HE ZAINAB YE MUJSE, DEKH KAR CHEHRA MERA\nAAP KE RUKHSAAR PAR YE, NEEL HE KAYSA PARA\nME NE KHAYA HE TAMACHA, MAT BATANA, YA ALI
english translation text: SEEING MY FACE, ZAINAB SAYS TO ME\nHOW DID YOU GET THAT BRUISE ON YOUR CHEEK\nBUT DON’T MENTION TO HER THAT I HAVE BEEN SLAPPED, O ALI

arabic text: TAZIYANE KI AZIYYAT, KA UTHAANA EK TARAF\nWOH TAMACHE, QATL E MOHSIN, DAR JALANA EK TARAF\nSAB SE MUSHKIL THA MAGAR, DARBAR JANA, YA ALI
english translation text: THE PAIN FROM BEING WHIPPED, IS ONE THING\nBEING SLAPPED, MURDER OF MOHSIN AND THE BURNING DOOR IS ANOTHER THING\nHOWEVER, GOING TO THE COURT WAS STILL THE MOST DIFFICULT, O ALI

arabic text: JAB MERI TALQEEN PARHNA, YAAD KAR LENA ZARA\nDAR KE GHIR NE SE MERA, BAZU BHI HE TUTA HUWA\nMERE SHANO KO ZARA, DHEERE HILANA, YA ALI
english translation text: WHEN YOU READ MY TALQEEN, PLEASE KEEP IN MIND\nMY BROKEN ARM FROM BEING TRAPPED BEHIND THE BURNING DOOR\nSHAKE MY ARMS (FOR TALQEEN) GENTLY, O ALI

arabic text: CHAHE AA JAYE QAYAMAT, MUJH SE YE WAADA KARO\nJAB TALAK MOLA MERE, SHABBIR KI MARZI NA HO\nTAB TALAK MERA JANAZA, MAT UTHANA, YA ALI
english translation text: PROMISE ME, NO MATTER WHAT HAPPENS, EVEN IF IT IS THE QIYAMA\nUNTIL MY SHABBIR (MAULA HUSSAIN A.S) DOES NOT AGREE AND LET GO\nUNTIL THEN, DO NOT BEGIN MY FUNERAL, O ALI

arabic text: JAB SE AAYI HUN PALAT KAR, FIKR HE MUJH KO YEHI\nME TO PARDE ME GAYE PHIR, BHI ZA'EEFA HO GAYI\nBE RIDA DARBAR HAI, ZAINAB KO JANA, YA ALI
english translation text: EVER SINCE I RETURNED FROM THE COURT, IT BOTHERS ME THAT\nI WENT WITH MY VEIL INTACT AND IT TOOK SUCH A TOLL ON ME\nZAINAB WILL HAVE TO GO TO THE COURT UNVEILED, O ALI
